battle.name: 陳家島海戰
battle.brief: 紹興三十一年十月丙寅，金主完顏亮遣水軍自山東出海，擬循海路溯江直取臨安。宋沿海水軍統制李寶率舟師於唐島（陳家島）外海截擊，以火矢、火藥箭夾船載配重投石車壓其鐵甲，宋軍自晨至暮焚溺相接，金水師幾乎全滅，海路進攻之策遂破。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰雙方是南宋與金朝。金主完顏亮於紹興三十一年分四路大舉南下，沿海一路由山東出海，準備循海岸南下、尋隙入江，再溯江而上直取臨安；金廷以御前中樞統一調度舟師，沿海州郡徵發水軍戶、船戶與匠戶，戰船有新造的大海船，也有臨時徵用的平底沙船與民船，船上起篷房、載兵丁與軍需，地方守軍與水軍混編，歸主帥節制。南宋方面，朝廷以樞密院掌兵，江淮與兩浙沿江設水軍，負責海防的是沿海水軍、兩浙西路水軍與淮東水軍；李寶所領一部舟師以海船為編制單位，每船載弓弩手、火工、舵工與水手，另配合由福建、兩浙調來的船戶以及海商改裝的商船。雙方實力對比懸殊：金軍船多兵眾、鐵甲新製，南宋舟師人數有限，但熟悉近海潮流與島礁，因此選在唐島一帶水道截擊。
countriesEn: The two parties were the Southern Song and the Jin dynasty. In the thirty-first year of the Shaoxing era the Jurchen emperor Wanyan Liang launched a four-pronged invasion of the south, and the coastal column was to sail out of Shandong, move down the seaboard, find a gap into the Yangtze and then push upriver to strike straight at Lin'an. The Jin court directed the fleet through the central command at the emperor's own headquarters; the coastal prefectures levied boatmen, shipwrights and crews, and the flotilla mixed newly built seagoing ships with hastily requisitioned flat-bottomed sand boats and private craft, with plank sheds erected on deck to carry soldiers and stores. On the Song side the Secretariat of War held the military authority, and water forces were posted along the Yangtze in Jianghuai and the two Zhe circuits: the coastal navy, the water force of the Zhexi circuit and the water force of Huaidong. The detachment under Li Bao was organised ship by ship, each hull carrying crossbowmen, fire workers, helmsmen and rowers, reinforced by crews drafted from Fujian and the Zhe circuits and by merchant vessels converted into warships. The mismatch was stark: the Jin had more ships, more men and newly built iron-plated hulls, while the Song fleet was far smaller but knew the local currents and shoals, and chose to meet the enemy in the waters off Tang Island.
people: 完顏亮是這一戰役的起點。他自正隆五年起整軍備戰，把金朝可用的人力、馬匹、鐵料全數壓上，強徵民夫造大船，並決心一次滅宋，不接受和議；沿海一路原是他四路大軍中的奇兵，企圖避開采石、瓜洲等要塞與宋軍主力，直接由海路插入江南。金方沿海舟師的統帥，在金、宋兩系記錄中多只見都統一類的稱號，姓名流傳不一，因此只能確定此人自山東率軍入海，無法坐實具體名諱。宋方最關鍵的人物是沿海水軍統制李寶，一般記錄以他為此戰主帥：他率舟師自沿海出發，在唐島外海擋住金軍，決定了這一戰的勝負。同一戰役另一線，采石防線由中書舍人虞允文督視，淮東水軍則由韓世忠封鎖瓜洲、真州一帶江面，使金主的御舟師無法順利西下，兩處呼應，把金軍夾在黃海與長江之間。完顏亮在江南連遭挫敗後，部將完顏元宜等於瓜洲將他殺死，金軍隨即北撤。
peopleEn: Wanyan Liang was the origin of this campaign. From the fifth year of the Zhenglong era he had been reorganising the army, committing every man, horse and ingot of iron the Jin possessed, conscripting labourers to build great ships, and he was determined to destroy the Song in one stroke rather than negotiate. The coastal column was meant to be the surprise element of his four armies, meant to slip past the fortresses at Caishi and Guazhou and past the main body of the Song army and enter Jiangnan directly from the sea. The name of the Jin commander of that fleet is given only as a rank of the kind used for commanders-in-chief in the Jin and Song records, and the forms differ, so what can be stated with certainty is that a commander led the fleet out of Shandong and to sea, not who he was. The decisive figure on the Song side was Li Bao, commander of the coastal navy, recorded as the field commander of this battle: he took his ships out from the coast and blocked the Jin at sea off Tang Island, which settled the outcome. On the other front of the same campaign the line at Caishi was supervised by Yu Yunwen, a director of the Secretariat, while Han Shizhong's Huadong water force sealed the river around Guazhou and Zhenzhou so that the emperor's own fleet could not slip down the river; the two pincered the Jin between the Yellow Sea and the Yangtze. After repeated defeats south of the river, Wanyan Liang was killed at Guazhou by his own officers, led by Wanyan Yuanyi, and the Jin armies withdrew north.
kits: 卡面的配重投石車，是十二世紀東西各地通行的重型拋石器械：以長臂、短樑與配重箱組成，靠釋放配重把石塊拋出，射程遠、拋物弧高，十二世紀時在攻城、據壘與水戰中都有實際用途。中國方面，《武經總要》已收錄各類拋石砲法，南宋江防與水軍都配備這類器械：岸上砲台用來封鎖江面、砸擊浮橋與渡船，大船與車船上亦可設船載拋石機，拋射石塊以及盛著油藥的陶罐。在陳家島這一役，砲的位置是輔助而非決定：金的舟師以鐵甲包板，箭矢難以穿入，宋軍便以火矢與火藥箭覆蓋篷頂、以火船撞近引火，殘餘船隻再由弩砲與投石機砸擊甲板與船艙。其餘常見裝備還包括神臂弓、蹶張弓與床子弩這類蹶張弩砲，以及火油、火藥箭、鷹船與海鰍船；金軍則有車船、平底沙船、鐵浮圖一類鐵甲船，以及用來架渡的浮橋與板屋。
kitsEn: The trebuchet on the card is the heavy stone-throwing engine common across Eurasia in the twelfth century: a long throwing arm, a short beam and a counterweight box, the arm released so that the falling weight flung a stone out on a high arc, giving it long range and a steep trajectory, and in the twelfth century it had real use in sieges, in field fortifications and in river warfare. In China the Wujing Zongyao already catalogues several varieties of stone-throwing artillery, and the Southern Song used the type both in the river defence and in its fleets: shore batteries emplaced to seal the river and to smash pontoon bridges and ferry boats, and ship-borne engines mounted on large hulls and on wheeled barges that threw stones as well as jars of oil and chemicals. In the fighting off Chenjia Island the artillery was a support arm rather than the decisive one. The Jin hulls were plated with iron and arrows could not bite into them, so the Song covered the deck sheds with fire arrows and gunpowder arrows, drove fire ships in to set them alight, and only then brought crossbow artillery and the throwing engines to bear on the hulls and cabins of the burning vessels. The rest of the standard equipment included the divine arm bow, the strong pull crossbow and heavy crossbow artillery, together with fire oil, gunpowder arrows, hawk boats and loach boats; the Jin had wheeled barges, flat-bottomed sand boats, iron-clad vessels of the tiefutu kind, and pontoon bridges and plank sheds for crossing.
tactics: 宋軍的作戰以火攻為主、砲火為輔，程序相當固定。接戰前先以小船與偵察船探明金船隊的錨泊位置與排列次序，再把主力分成數列橫排，堵住唐島與外海之間的潮流通道，斷金軍回航之路。攻擊時先用火箭與火藥箭齊射，專打金船的篷房與桅索；火船趁勢撞近，把薪柴、膏油一併點燃；待金船起火、陣形混亂，弩砲與投石機才壓上去砸擊火中船身，阻止金兵跳船反撲。最後是分割殲滅與奪船，殘存小艇往來搜索，截住企圖逃入外海的散船。金軍一方因船型大、吃水深、轉向遲緩，無法在狹窄水道展開兵力優勢，只能結集成團防守，被火矢覆蓋後船隊次序大亂。宋軍保持縱深，以後列舟師接續掩護，記錄亦提到宋軍曾於夜裡逼近停泊中的金船，趁夜焚燒其篷艙；十一月黃海多東北季風，火船順風而發更為迅疾。
tacticsEn: The Song plan put fire first and artillery second, and the sequence was tightly ordered. Before contact, small boats and scouting craft located the anchorage of the Jin fleet and the order of its line; the main force then formed in several ranks lying across the channel between Tang Island and the open sea, to cut off the Jin route back out. The attack opened with a volley of fire arrows and gunpowder arrows aimed at the deck sheds and rigging of the Jin ships. Fire boats, loaded with brushwood and oil, then closed in and set them burning. Only once the Jin ships were alight and their order had broken did the crossbow artillery and the stone-throwing engines come forward, smashing the burning hulls and stopping the Jin soldiers from leaping to safety. The last stage was to cut up the survivors and seize their ships, small boats ranging about to intercept stragglers trying to escape to open water. The Jin side, with large hulls, deep draught and slow turning, could not deploy its superiority in the narrow channel and could only bunch up and defend; once the fire arrows found the deck sheds, the order of the fleet dissolved. The Song kept depth, with rear echelons of shipping covering the advance, and the records also describe Song boats closing on the anchored Jin ships at night to burn their deck shelters; in the eleventh month the Yellow Sea carries a north-easterly, and fire boats driven by that wind came in fast.
data: 時間：南宋紹興三十一年十月丙寅，即西曆1161年11月16日；地點：黃海唐島（又名陳家島）外海，約在北緯35.9度、東經120.1度一帶，屬今日青島市黃島區西南海域，島嶼名稱與位置經八百餘年河道海岸變遷已難完全對應。兵力：金朝沿海一路舟師的規模，各種記錄說法不一，兵員常以萬計、戰船以百計；南宋出動的是沿海水軍一部，船數遠少於金軍。交戰歷時自晨至暮，記錄提及火船順東北季風而發、金船多被焚燒或被砲石砸沉，海面浮屍與斷木相連；但斬首、俘虜與沉船的精確數目各書不一，本篇不引用無憑的精確數字。交戰方在技術上的差距可由器物看出：金船多有鐵甲包板與起竿絞索之屬，宋船則以快船、鷹船與海鰍船見長，弓弩配發數倍於金。可確定的是，戰後金朝由海路入江的企圖完全落空，同月其主力在采石再遭重創。
dataEn: Date: the bingyin day of the tenth month of the thirty-first year of the Shaoxing era, that is 16 November 1161 in the western calendar. Place: the open water off Tang Island, also called Chenjia Island, in the Yellow Sea, roughly at 35.9 degrees north and 120.1 degrees east, in what is now the southwestern sea area of Huangdao District in Qingdao; after more than eight hundred years of shifts in channel and shoreline, the name and the exact position of the island can no longer be matched with certainty. Strength: the size of the Jin coastal fleet is given differently in different records, the men usually counted by the ten thousand and the ships by the hundred; the Song committed only part of the coastal navy, with far fewer hulls than the enemy. The action ran from morning until dusk, and the records note fire boats running with the north-easterly and Jin ships burning or crushed to the bottom by stones, with bodies and broken spars floating across the water. The exact counts of the slain, the prisoners and the sunken ships differ from account to account, and no unsupported precise figure is given here. The gap in technique between the two sides shows in their equipment: the Jin ships were mostly plated with iron and carried sheers and windlasses for working their masts, while the Song relied on fast hulls, hawk boats and loach boats, and carried crossbows in numbers several times the Jin's. What can be stated is that the Jin plan to enter the Yangtze from the sea had failed completely, and that in the same month their main force was badly beaten at Caishi.
cause: 金主完顏亮自靖康之變以來一直以北伐滅宋為志。紹興三十一年他整頓的準備已近完成，拒絕議和，把全國分成四路大軍同時南下，準備在宋廷措手不及時一舉渡江，直取臨安。海上這一路是四路中最出奇的一手：宋軍多年以來把重兵佈在采石、瓜洲、真州等江防要點，金軍便想用海路從山東沿海岸南下，避開正面要塞，找一處船隊能入江的缺口，再溯江而上，直取宋廷所在。促成此戰的直接原因，是金軍海上出動的情報被宋方偵知，臨安朝廷隨即以沿海水軍出擊，選擇在唐島外海這片宋方熟悉的近海水道迎敵。金廷為此役徵船、徵役、徵料甚急，沿海州縣連年造大船，民間商船亦被編入軍用，才湊出這支遠征海上的舟師。宋廷多年經營的造船與水軍體系也在此時發揮作用：舟材來源穩定、水軍戶編制完整、且已習慣駕船出海，於是雙方在黃海唐島外海遭遇。
causeEn: Since the Jingkang disaster the Jurchen emperor had made the northward war and the destruction of the Song his standing aim. By the thirty-first year of Shaoxing his preparations were all but complete, he refused negotiation, and he split the country into four armies that advanced at once, aiming to cross the river before the Song court could react and to take Lin'an. The sea column was the strangest of the four, because the Song had for years massed its strength at the river points of Caishi, Guazhou and Zhenzhou; the Jin therefore proposed to use the sea, to run down the coast from Shandong, to avoid the fortresses on the direct line, to find an opening where a fleet could enter the river, and then to push upriver to the seat of the Song government. The immediate cause of this battle was that word of the Jin fleet putting to sea reached the Song, and the court at Lin'an sent the coastal navy out to meet it in the near-shore water the Song knew best, off Tang Island. The Song naval establishment also had to be ready for it: a steady supply of timber, a fully enrolled body of boatmen, and crews already used to handling ships on the open sea. The Jin court strained for hulls, labour and materials for this operation: the coastal prefectures built great ships year after year, and private merchant craft were taken into military service, and only thus was the fleet that was to sail so far from home assembled. The two fleets met in the Yellow Sea off Tang Island.
impact: 陳家島海戰的結果不只改變一次海戰的勝負，也直接改寫了金朝南下計畫的整體格局。完顏亮把沿海一路視為奇兵，舟師全滅之後，他不僅失去最後一支奇兵，也失去繞過江防的可能，於是把兵力全部壓向采石正面，十餘日後再遭大敗。金廷內部的不滿隨之累積：完顏亮性情峻急、賞罰不公，金軍久攻不下、士氣低落，1162年2月他被部將完顏元宜等殺於瓜洲，金軍北撤，宋金重歸對峙，翌年議和劃界，江南因此換來相對安定的數年。對南宋而言，此役證明以舟師配合火藥與火攻，足以抵擋裝備精良、人數眾多的敵軍，也刺激朝廷更重視造船、弩砲與火藥武器的發展；此後南宋水軍在對金、對蒙古的多次江海作戰中，都沿用火船、火箭與砲火結合的思路，江防體系由純粹依託天塹轉向舟船、火器與城寨並重。
impactEn: The outcome of the fight off Chenjia Island changed more than the fate of one engagement; it reshaped the shape of the Jin invasion plan as a whole. Wanyan Liang had treated the coastal column as his surprise force. With the fleet destroyed he lost not only his last surprise but any possibility of turning the river defence, so he concentrated everything on the direct line at Caishi and was beaten there again within a fortnight. Resentment inside the Jin court built up: Wanyan Liang was harsh, his rewards and punishments were capricious, and the army, stalled before the river, lost heart. In February 1162 his officers, led by Wanyan Yuanyi, killed him at Guazhou; the Jin withdrew north, the two states returned to confrontation, and the following year's peace settlement and boundary drew a spell of relative calm over Jiangnan. For the Song, the battle showed that ships worked with gunpowder and fire could hold off an enemy far better equipped and far more numerous, and it pushed the court to invest more in shipbuilding, heavy crossbow artillery and gunpowder weapons. In later river and sea fighting against both the Jin and the Mongols, the Southern Song navy kept to the same combination of fire ships, fire arrows and artillery, and its river defence came to rest on ships, fire weapons and fortified banks together rather than on the natural barrier alone.
result: 宋軍全勝，金軍沿海舟師幾乎全滅。接戰時金軍以大船結隊，雖有鐵甲與浮橋可倚仗，但船體笨重、又遭火箭覆蓋篷頂，火船逼近後火勢連片，殘餘船隻被弩砲與投石機擊碎，金兵落水與被焚者極多，餘者由小船追截，僅少量逃回北方。宋軍本身以舟師主動出擊，未讓金軍取得任何上岸的立足點，金主由海路直取臨安的計畫就此破滅。同一戰役中，采石江上的御舟師亦被宋軍擊退，兩役相加，金朝南侵的攻勢在長江下游被徹底擋住。金主完顏亮在隨後的混亂中被部將所弒，金軍北撤，宋金在紹興三十二年議和後回到以江淮為界的老局面，陳家島海戰則成為南宋海防史上最明亮的一筆。此役之後，宋廷對沿海水軍與造船工坊的調度更為緊密，江上守軍與海上巡邏舟師之間的傳訊、接應與撤退次序，都按此役的經驗重新修訂，而金朝海上的進攻能力則自此一蹶不振。
resultEn: The Song won outright and the Jin coastal fleet was practically annihilated. The Jin had closed up with their great ships, and although they could rely on iron plating and pontoons, their hulls were clumsy, the fire arrows reached the deck sheds, and once the fire boats closed in the flames ran from ship to ship. The surviving craft were broken up by crossbow artillery and thrown stones, and the Jin troops burned or drowned in numbers; only a few were chased down by the Song boats and made it back north. The Song had gone out to sea on their own initiative and allowed the Jin no foothold ashore at all, so the plan of reaching Lin'an from the sea died there. In the same campaign the emperor's own fleet was also driven back at the river at Caishi, and between the two actions the Jin offensive in the lower Yangtze was completely stopped. Wanyan Liang was then killed by his own officers amid the resulting disorder, the Jin armies withdrew, and after the peace negotiated in the thirty-second year of Shaoxing the two states returned to the old arrangement with the river and Huai as the line. The fight off Chenjia Island remains the brightest page in the naval history of the Southern Song. After this action the Song court tightened its control over the coastal navy and the shipyards, and the signalling, the mutual support and the order of withdrawal between the river garrisons and the sea patrols were all revised in the light of what had happened here, while the Jin capacity for seaborne attack never recovered.
